name: get_message
description:
Retrieve the full content of a specific Outlook email message, including the complete body text/HTML, all headers (To, Cc, Bcc), categories, and attachment metadata.

Use this tool when you need to:
- Read the full body of an email (outlook_search only returns previews/snippets)
- Get the complete email content before drafting a reply
- Check all recipients (including Cc/Bcc) of a message
- See attachment metadata before downloading with outlook_attachment_download_artifact (preferred when you want the file in the sandbox)

The message_id should come from a previous outlook_search result.

When presenting results:
- Summarize key information from the email body
- Include relevant headers when useful to the user
- Do not fabricate content - only use what is returned

message_id.description: The Outlook message ID to retrieve. Use a message_id from outlook_search results.
